title: Integrability of a continuous radial profile g(|x - y|/t) that vanishes beyond T
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, E := R^{n+l} (Euclidean space), mu a measure on E, y in E, g : R -> R and S, T, t real numbers. Write B_S(y) for the closed ball of radius S about y. Assume: mu(B_S(y)) < infinity; g is continuous; g(u) = 0 for every u > T; t > 0; and T t < S. Then the real function x -> g(|x - y|/t) is mu-integrable on E.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (y : Amb n ℓ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (S T t : ℝ), μ (closedBall y S) < ⊤ → Continuous g → (∀ u : ℝ, T < u → g u = 0) → 0 < t → T * t < S → Integrable (fun x => g (‖x - y‖ / t)) μ
